name: ColorArea
summary: The square where you pick a colour's saturation and brightness for one hue, by pointer, touch or keyboard. The screen reader hears the channels and the colour's name.

a11y.apg: A group with two hidden range inputs, one per axis (saturation and brightness), announced as a 2D slider. Only one is in the Tab order. Before you move it, each input's value names the three channels and the colour; after a keyboard change, only the channel that changed and the colour.
a11y.keyboardNote: Arrows move one step (Shift: ten). Page Up/Down change the brightness by ten, Home/End the saturation by ten. Left and right swap when the text runs right to left.

props.name: value
props.description: The colour in hex (#rrggbb or #rgb), controlled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting colour when you do not control it.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Called when the pointer is released and on every key — the moment to save.

props.name: name
props.description: Sends the colour with a form, as #rrggbb.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the colour is for ("Background"). The inputs are named "Background, Color picker"; without it, "Color picker".

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Names the group and the inputs by another element's id.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the area, after the Aurea skin.
